about: Official files Band Atlas reads. Each entry is fetched on schedule by .github/workflows/fetch-official.yml; what was found is written to official/<id>/meta.json and a short sample to official/<id>/sample.txt. Raw files are attached to the release 'official-data'.

items.what: Installations radioélectriques de plus de 5 watts, whole country (monthly ZIPs: stations, transmitters with their system such as '5G NR 3500', operators); summarised by tools/parse_anfr.py
Connected Nations 2025 data downloads: the mobile coverage files linked from the page
ECO Report 03, the licensing of mobile bands in CEPT (PDF; a new edition changes the checksum)
National Broadband Map: probe only (the data download needs choosing a provider; this records whether the listing answers)
